# Mookmati, The Silent Earth Studio

> Mookmati (mookmati.in) is an Indian brand selling handmade home textiles and crafts guided by ahimsa (non-violence), inspired by Acharya Shri Vidyasagar Ji Maharaj and his epic Mookmati. Current products are hand block-printed 100% cotton bedsheets from Rajasthan, 108 x 108 inches, priced at Rs 1,500 with free shipping across India. Orders are placed on WhatsApp (+91 94566 01984) or Instagram (@mookmatistudio). Store: GF193, Gaur City Center, Noida Extension (Greater Noida West), Uttar Pradesh, India.

## Products
- [Hand block-printed cotton bedsheets](https://mookmati.in/bedsheets.html): category overview, sizes, care and FAQs
- [Blue Coral Flower Bedsheet Set](https://mookmati.in/bedsheet-blue-coral-flower.html): hand block-printed, natural dyes, 100% cotton, 108 x 108 in, 2 pillow covers, Rs 1,500
- [Rajasthani Floral Super King Bedsheet](https://mookmati.in/bedsheet-rajasthani-floral-super-king.html): Rajasthani block print style, 100% cotton, 108 x 108 in, Rs 1,500
- [All products](https://mookmati.in/shop.html): sarees, handloom, jewellery, home decor, serveware and handicrafts coming soon
